title: Tree Guide Lines Emphasize On Hover
description: Tree indentation guide lines should turn emphasized when hovering over a tree item row.
summary: Vertical tree indentation guide lines were hidden under row hover backgrounds while horizontal elbows (inside each row) stayed visible. Raised [data-slot="tree-guide"] to z-index: 1 in TreeHoverPath CSS so branch-level vertical lines paint above row hover fills while remaining pointer-events-none.
